description: Sachi Urano publishes reproducibility code for stress-testing AI-assisted emergency triage as a finite-resource workflow. The August 2026 ZIP download includes configuration, source-data hash locks, tests and publication builders under BSD-3-Clause. The code requires MIMIC-IV-ED 2.2 and MIMIC-IV 3.1, which credentialed researchers must obtain separately from PhysioNet. It excludes patient-level data and derivatives, fitted models, author-run outputs and the private complete execution package. The workflow can support simulations of resource constraints and downstream burden transfer in emergency care. The public summary leaves detailed service distributions and software dependencies unknown. Provider-reported agreement between private reproduction runs does not establish that every analysis can run from the public package alone. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this code. No credentialed data were requested, downloaded or analysed.
